latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Compressor 8MB.

- Compresses video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) to fit within 8MB target size, optimized for quality.
- No manual sliders; just upload and request compression by file size.
- Handles session management and cloud GPU rendering automatically; notifies when setup is ready.
- Accepts plain user prompts for compression, export, and common workflows.
- Supports batch operations, state management, credits checking, and export/download actions.
- Provides clear error codes and tips for a smoother experience.
